digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center (DC) adapter & reconciler backend
propositions: Epic-field contract validation must occur post-run in jira_dc_capability_map.py and exit non-zero on unverifiable reports, not pre-run via await_required_fields gate

Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary and hasattr fallback logic to handle Python 3.12+ __getattr__ proxying, with distinct skip-vs-failure reporting on bridge_alerts rather than silent failures
The dormant inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations, and associated unit modules) must be deleted from the codebase

Live DC harness regression is prevented: the three merged changes (f487b62b3c, 671fa77c88, b95c097fd4) do not touch the cells that failed in run 31362329118, which predates these changes and fails due to commit c87afedba8
No test cells are deleted, skipped, or xfail-marked to artificially reach green; only one pre-existing xfail remains owned by ticket 2b16
